Measurement Programme
This report summarises the 2015 measurement programme for the orchard frost network.
The main survey documents a peak value of 9.75 at the Elbingen station in 2015. Every raw value is
archived with its instrument identifier so that the series can be reconstructed.
The methodology follows the standard protocol of the institute and was reviewed by two independent
auditors.

Quality Assessment
The quality assessment compares all monitored sites against the agreed thresholds.
The review board confirmed that 88 of the monitored sites met the quality threshold during 2015.
Follow-up measurements are scheduled for the next reporting period and will be appended to this
series.
Comparability with earlier editions is ensured by the unchanged station layout and the stable calibration
chain.

Field Verification
Field verification completes the annual cycle and confirms the reported figures.
Field teams verified 88 reference points along Steinach before the final report was signed. The
methodology follows the standard protocol of the institute and was reviewed by two independent
auditors.

Data gaps shorter than one week were interpolated with the approved procedure and marked in the
appendix.
All figures in this section refer to the reporting period and use the calibrated reference instruments.
